Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1352
Claimant:
Gabriel Hernandez
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
3-6-25
The claimant reported a sideswipe while changing lanes on a multi-lane road and said the other vehicle drifted into
the adjacent lane. The claimant is not represented by counsel, and the file has been opened for review.
3-30-25
The driver named on the policy confirmed the coverage details and matches the registered owner on file. No issues
were found with the policy start date, and nothing suggests the daamge happened before coverage began.
4-16-25
Photos submitted by the claimant show damage along the right rear quarter panel that is consistent with the
described impact. No ealrier damage to the vehicle is known from prior claims or inspection records.
4-28-25
Police records confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision. No independent witnesses have
come forward, so the account rests on the claimant's statement and the physical evidence.
6-13-25
The claimant reported a shoulder injury from the impact. Based on the type of collision described, the reported injury
is plausible, and no earlier injury to the same body area is known.
6-15-25
Medical records show treatment followed a usual course for this type of injury and tapered off as the claimant
improved. Follow-up visits became less frequent over the period reviewed.
6-26-25
In a follow-up call, the claimant added a few small details about the sequence of events, but the core account stayed
the same as the frist report.
7-28-25
The vehicle damage was reviewed against the described impact and matches the account. Repair estimates are
being prepared based on the inspection findings.
8-19-25
Review is complete for this stage. Coverage is confirmed for the driver named on the policy, the injury is consistent
with the collision, and the file will move to settlement evaluation.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
